title: LADA R vs Strange Brews, Nov 2
notes: Away game at Snoqualmie A against Strange Brews: we wore light blue on the away bench at the near right, the Brews white with red and navy trim.

Periods from the arena scoreboard's clock: 0:04-18:11, 19:49-38:16 and 39:54-66:14 of the video. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; the video reaches the final horn. The clock reader first ended the 3rd at 63:50: the board held 1:02 through a timeout with its leading 1 too faint to read, then showed 1:00, which read as 0:00. Play went on for another 2:24, and tracking had stopped at the wrong end, so the lineup over the last 2:24 comes from a by-eye check (Soubochev, Bogdanov, Vorobyov, Bekker and Shikhanov, no change).

Who played: 12 skaters, the sheet's list less Perry #99. Our goalie wore a black jersey with a 1 on it; the sheet marks Perry #99 (a sub, in goal on Oct 19 too) as playing and not Willis #35, so the goalie is taken to be Perry. Didn't play: Willis #35, Shanygin #8, Belousenko #11, Shanygin #72, Fateev #80 and Severtokov #84. The reads of an 8 were all Dotsenko's 81.

Goals from SportNinja's game sheet, placed in the video and checked by eye: 1:28 (clock 16:41, 1st, Strange Brews' #37 Landau), 7:06 (10:56, #57 Moshchuk from #64 and #39), 12:38 (5:26, #57 Moshchuk from #39 and #9, on the power play), 24:48 (13:01, 2nd, #92 Shachak from #9 and #39), 32:10 (5:38, #9 Soubochev from #92), 37:14 (0:39, Strange Brews' #79 Kopp from #27), 40:54 (16:58, 3rd, Strange Brews' #19 Lipavsky from #58), 41:51 (16:28, Strange Brews' #27 Deyo from #37), 52:57 (8:45, #12 Sergeev from #70, shorthanded) and 66:11 (0:02, #66 Bekker). The board posted the last goal 8 s after the horn and the 4-2 goal 12 s late. Final 6-4.

Penalties: Makhalov #36 sat 50:15-54:22 for roughing (Sergeev's shorthanded goal didn't end it). Strange Brews' #79 Kopp sat 10:04-13:05 for tripping, and Moshchuk's second goal came on that power play.

Lineups were checked by eye: 27 on/off spans fix line changes the tracker missed, from two rounds of checkers. A stretch at 1:47-2:05 of the video really had four of ours on the ice, through a stoppage and the faceoff after it. In the shot goal clips the replay of the 1-1 and 3-1 goals starts earlier than the shot, at the drive that started each scramble.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 16:41: Strange Brews' #37 Landau from the slot past our goalie, 0-1
1st period, clock 10:56: Shtin drives the net and Moshchuk jams it in at the post, 1-1
1st period, clock 5:26: on the power play, Vorobyov shoots from the slot and Moshchuk jams in the rebound, 2-1
2nd period, clock 13:01: Shachak pokes it in from the right of the net after a long scramble, 3-1
2nd period, clock 5:38: Soubochev shoots from the left of the crease, 4-1
2nd period, clock 0:39: Strange Brews' #79 Kopp from #27, a shot from the slot, 4-2
3rd period, clock 16:58: Strange Brews' #19 Lipavsky from #58, driving the crease, 4-3
3rd period, clock 16:28: Strange Brews' #27 Deyo from #37, off a scramble at our crease, 4-4
3rd period, clock 8:45: shorthanded, Shikhanov feeds from the right and Sergeev tucks it in at the crease, 5-4
3rd period, clock 0:02: Bekker gets past a diving defender and tucks it in at the left post with two seconds left, 6-4
